description: Randomizer expander for any Rainbow sequencer, placed immediately to the right of it, with four buttons and triggers that randomize notes on it

params.text: Randomizes the notes chosen for that button; holding it for a second enters configuration mode, where clicking a note on the sequencer adds it to or removes it from that button's set

inputs.text: A rising edge randomizes the notes chosen for that button

notes: With no Rainbow sequencer immediately to its left this module does nothing: the notes it randomizes are the sequencer's
A Rainbow sequencer takes only one randomizer expander; a second one is refused with the message Randomizer Expander already attached
